detail: Default keep restored owner service and WAN routing. Reinstall retained the claimed owner, desired policy, UI certificate and running signed core.
Purge removed the identified data tree and all owned bindings. The sibling file, original certificate, API grants and owner forwarding rules survived.
Foreign ARP and bridge-host natural keys and a substituted same-name certificate independently refused teardown before a change.
An interruption after native container removal retained a durable marker. The original uninstaller finished cleanup, then repeated without changing owner state.
